I am currently a Master of Data Science (MDS) student at the University of British Columbia. Prior to joining the program, I worked as a Learning Systems Analyst at STEMCELL Technologies for nearly four years and I earned my Bachelor of Health Sciences from Simon Fraser University. Through the MDS program, I am developing technical data science skills to support a career transition into data focused roles. My goal is to apply data science and analytics to improve decision-making and outcomes in healthcare.
